limits: Quiet timings, sampled runs and instrumented counts are separate experiments.
Two fixed-fixture baseline processes and one alternating movement process; not keyboard-to-display latency.
Charge decreases identify collections but do not count multiple collections within a phase.
Stable-live explicit collection sampling excludes the large dead-object population of automatic collection pauses.
Copy count window covers eight full-map draws and teardown; counts are combined memcpy/memmove observations, not per-callsite attribution.
Language timings include prepared-block invocation overhead; counts use one post-warmup invocation and are not hot-path CPU percentages.
